info.title: QuantDinger Agent Gateway
info.description: Versioned, scoped surface for AI agents. Distinct from the human web API (/api/...). All routes except /health require a Bearer agent token. See docs/agent/AGENT_QUICKSTART.md and docs/agent/MCP_SETUP.md.

error.description: Failure reason. A structured `JobFailure` object when the runner raised a structured error (for example `strategyV2.backtestRangeLimit`), otherwise a plain string.

JobFailure.description: Structured job failure. Thread and Celery runners persist the same shape.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, including suggested fixes when available

BacktestRangeLimitDetails.description: Returned in `details` of the 400 from POST /backtest/run and in `error.details` of a job that failed for the same reason. `fetch_days` covers the selected range plus indicator warmup.

max_days.description: Maximum calendar days per fetch, warmup included

warmup_days.description: Calendar days needed by the indicator warmup

recommendation_available.description: False when the warmup alone exceeds the limit

recommended_start.description: Start date that fits when keeping the requested end date

recommended_end.description: End date that fits when keeping the requested start date

BacktestRunMetrics.description: Summary metrics. Values are null when the run did not record them (for example `totalFees` on runs persisted before fee totals were stored; read the run to get `result.totalCommission`).

totalFees.description: Total commission paid, in account currency

codeHash.description: Hash of the strategy source that produced the run; equal hashes mean identical code

result.description: Full stored backtest result (compacted history payload)

BacktestReport.description: Markdown report rendered from one persisted run. The Backtest Center download (`GET /api/backtest/report`) returns the identical document for the same run and language.

markdown.description: Sections: summary (period, market, timeframe, capital, final equity, total return vs buy-and-hold, max drawdown, Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar), cost breakdown (commission, slippage, funding, cost share of gross profit and loss), trade diagnostics (win rate, average R, expectancy before and after costs, holding-time distribution, MAE/MFE), execution assumptions and model limitations, warnings (data gaps, benchmark coverage, sampled history), and strategy version (sourceId, version when recorded, code hash). Fields the run did not record read as the localized "no data" text.

DataCoverage.description: Returned in `data` by GET /data-coverage. The range verdict is produced by the same rule as the POST /backtest/run precheck and the job-time check.

status.description: `unknown` when the data source cannot report its first candle; no date is estimated

validation_market.description: Market whose provider limit applies (catalog underlying market for tokenized equities)

max_days.description: Maximum calendar days per fetch, warmup included

warmup_days.description: Calendar days fetched before start_date for warmup

max_selected_days.description: Largest end_date minus start_date in days once warmup is reserved

warmup_fits.description: False when the warmup alone exceeds max_days

evaluation.description: Null unless start_date and end_date are given.

ok.description: Same verdict as the POST /backtest/run range precheck

violation.description: Identical to the `details` the backtest submission would return

status.description: `unknown` when the earliest bar is unknown

earliest_start.description: First start_date whose warmup fits after the earliest bar

recommended_start.description: Feasible start that keeps end_date; null when feasible or no fix exists

id.description: MCP check_environment also emits connectivity, authentication, and version

remediation.description: Suggested fix; null when the check passes

max_days.description: Maximum calendar days per fetch, warmup included

EnvironmentReport.description: Returned in `data` by GET /environment. Never contains the token value, hash, or id.

tenant_limit.description: Max queued/running agent jobs per tenant

tenant_active.description: Null when the count is unavailable

token_limit.description: Max queued/running agent jobs per token

available.description: Backtests that can be submitted now before HTTP 429

default.description: Timeframe to limit, for markets without an override

markets.description: Market to timeframe to limit overrides, filtered to the token market allowlist

token.description: Full token; shown ONCE — store securely

BacktestRequest.description: Provide exactly one of `code` (inline source) or `sourceId` (a saved, tenant-owned strategy source). `sourceVersion` selects a version of that source; omit it to use the latest version.

code.description: Strategy API V2 Python code using initialize(context) and a runtime handler. Mutually exclusive with sourceId.

sourceId.description: Saved strategy source owned by the caller's tenant. Another tenant's source returns 404.

sourceVersion.description: Per-source version number (`version_no` from GET /strategy-sources/{id}/versions). Requires sourceId; defaults to the latest version.

BacktestStrategySource.description: The saved strategy source version a backtest ran. Returned on the 202 receipt and in the job result as `strategySource` when the request used sourceId.

OptimizationParameterRange.description: Narrows one declared parameter. Numeric `min`/`max` must stay inside the declared range and `step` must be positive (an integer for integer parameters). Undeclared or non-optimizable parameters are rejected.

OptimizationSweepRequest.description: Parameter sweep on a saved, tenant-owned strategy source. Every combination is backtested on the in-sample window only; the best in-sample combination is then run once on the trailing out-of-sample window.

sourceVersion.description: Per-source version number; defaults to the latest version

commission.description: Omit to use the backend default

slippage.description: Omit to use the backend default

parameterSpace.description: Subset of the declared parameter space (GET /optimization/parameter-space). Omit to sweep every optimizable declared parameter over its declared range.

maxCombinations.description: Evaluate an evenly sampled subset of this size instead of the full grid. Must not exceed `limits.maxCombinations`.

embargoBars.description: Bars skipped between the in-sample and out-of-sample windows

outOfSampleRatio.description: Share of bars reserved for the out-of-sample window

OptimizationWalkForwardRequest.description: Anchored walk-forward study on a saved, tenant-owned strategy source. Per fold, the combination with the best training (in-sample) objective is validated on that fold's following window. The final `bestParams` are chosen on the development window and validated once on the trailing holdout.

trainRatio.description: Share of development bars in the first training window

holdoutRatio.description: Share of bars reserved for the final holdout that no selection step sees

OptimizationLimits.description: Operator caps (`AGENT_OPTIMIZATION_MAX_COMBINATIONS`, `AGENT_OPTIMIZATION_MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_TENANT`, `AGENT_OPTIMIZATION_MAX_DAILY_PER_TENANT`). The daily window resets at 00:00 UTC.

requested.description: Combination limit: combinations the request would evaluate

searchSpaceSize.description: Combination limit: size of the full requested grid

active.description: Concurrency limit: queued or running optimization jobs

used.description: Daily limit: optimization jobs submitted today (UTC)

combinations.description: Combinations the job will evaluate (before declared constraints)

activity.description: max(closed trades, executions); candidates with no activity are not ranked

OptimizationBestOutOfSample.description: How `bestParams` performed on data no selection step used: the out-of-sample window (sweep) or the holdout (walk-forward). `available` is false with a `reason` when the range was too short for a holdout.

passed.description: Active and positive return out of sample

OptimizationResult.description: `result` of a finished `parameter_optimization` job. In-sample (selection) and out-of-sample (validation only) metrics are reported separately; `history` holds the backtest-history run ids of `bestParams` on both windows (readable with GET /backtest/runs/{run_id}).

plan.description: Window boundaries; walk-forward adds the fold plan and holdout bounds

folds.description: Walk-forward only: each fold's training winner and its training metrics
Walk-forward only: each fold winner's validation metrics

summary.description: Walk-forward only: compoundedReturn, meanSharpeRatio, worstDrawdown, totalTrades, positiveFolds, validatedFolds, folds

tp_price.description: Optional take-profit price for live orders

sl_price.description: Optional stop-loss price for live orders

get.description: One-call readiness report for the calling token: backend version, scopes, paper-only mode, backtest concurrency quota (limits and active jobs), backtest range limits by market and timeframe, and token expiry. Each check is pass/warn/fail with a remediation hint. The token value, hash, and id are never returned. Read-only; no job or billing. The MCP tool check_environment adds connectivity and authentication checks.

post.summary: Compile Strategy API V2 source and return the canonical manifest without saving
post.description: Read scope is sufficient because compilation never persists sources, versions, or jobs and needs no Idempotency-Key. Discovery runs in the bounded compile sandbox, so a dedicated compile quota applies on top of the token quota: AGENT_COMPILE_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN per token (default 20) and AGENT_TENANT_COMPILE_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN per tenant (default 60). source_id reads only tenant-owned, non-hidden source code.

get.description: Compact tenant runtime overview: strategy counts, running strategy summaries, positions, pending orders, paper orders, and unrealized PnL.

post.description: Runs either inline `code` or a saved strategy source (`sourceId`, optional `sourceVersion`; latest version when omitted). The resolved version is pinned at submit time and reported as `strategySource` on the receipt and the job result. Compiles the strategy and checks the date range plus indicator warmup against the market/timeframe limit before a job is accepted or billed. An oversized range returns 400 with `message` `strategyV2.backtestRangeLimit` and `details` containing the limit, warmup days, and suggested dates.

202.description: Queued. Carries `strategySource` when the request used sourceId.

403.description: Market or instrument not allowed by the token, or the strategy source code is hidden

404.description: Strategy source or version not found for this tenant (including another tenant's source)

409.description: Strategy source has no saved version

400.description: Invalid request (including both or neither of code/sourceId), compile failure, or range/warmup limit exceeded (`details` is `BacktestRangeLimitDetails`)

get.summary: List persisted backtest runs with summary metrics
get.description: Tenant-scoped backtest history (the same records as the Backtest Center history), newest first. Each item carries `metrics` (return, max drawdown, trade count, win rate, total fees). A finished backtest job's `result.runId` identifies its run. Pagination uses `limit`/`offset`; `pagination.hasMore` reports whether another page exists.

get.description: Returns the run summary plus `manifest` and the full stored `result` (equity curve, trades, executions, attribution). Runs owned by another tenant return 404.

get.summary: Get one backtest run as a Markdown report
get.description: Renders the tenant-owned run as the shared Markdown backtest report (the same document the Backtest Center download returns). Every figure comes from the stored result; runs persisted before trade diagnostics still render, with the missing sections reading "no data". Runs owned by another tenant return 404.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Report language; `zh`, `en`, `zh_TW` style aliases are accepted

get.summary: Declared parameter space of a strategy source plus optimization limits
get.description: Returns the optimizable parameters declared by a tenant-owned strategy source version (the bounds every `parameterSpace` entry must stay within), the supported modes and objectives, and the operator limits.

404.description: Strategy source or version not found for this tenant

post.summary: Submit a parameter sweep job (in-sample selection, out-of-sample validation)
post.description: Queues a `parameter_optimization` job on a saved strategy source. The source version is pinned at submit time. The same compile, market/instrument allowlist, and range checks as POST /backtest/run apply. Every combination runs on the in-sample window; only the best one runs on the out-of-sample window. Poll GET /jobs/{job_id}; the result is an `OptimizationResult`. Limits: combinations per job (400), concurrent optimization jobs per tenant (429, retriable), optimization jobs per tenant per UTC day (429, not retriable until `resetAt`).

400.description: Invalid request, parameter range outside the declared space, compile or range failure, or combination limit exceeded (`details.error_type` `OPTIMIZATION_COMBINATION_LIMIT`)

403.description: Market or instrument not allowed by the token, or the strategy source code is hidden

404.description: Strategy source or version not found for this tenant

409.description: Strategy source has no saved version, or Idempotency-Key reused with a different request

post.description: Queues a `parameter_optimization` job on a saved strategy source with anchored walk-forward folds and a trailing holdout. Same source pinning, safety checks, and limits as POST /optimization/sweep. Poll GET /jobs/{job_id}; the result is an `OptimizationResult`.

get.description: Long-lived SSE stream. Frame types: `snapshot` (current job row), `progress` (each on_progress emission, with monotonic `seq`), `ping` (~15s keepalive), `result` (final). Resume after disconnect via `?since=<seq>` or `Last-Event-ID` header. If the job has already terminated when the client connects, `snapshot` and `result` are emitted immediately and the stream closes.

parameters.description: Standard SSE resume header; alternative to `since`.
